data.name: Ashfaque
data.gender_notes: Ashfaque is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ashfaque is derived from the Arabic name Ashraf, which means 'Noble' or 'Majestic'. The suffix -que in Ashfaque is derived from the Persian word 'Quli', meaning 'power' or 'strength'. Thus, Ashfaque can be interpreted as 'Noble Power' or 'Majestic Follower of the Moon'. The name Ashfaque carries the meaning “Follower of the Moon” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi, Urdu. Parents who choose Ashfaque usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of the moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ashfaque is a spiritual name that represents the connection between the individual and the divine power of the moon. It is believed that individuals with this name are blessed with the ability to harness the energy of the moon and use it for their personal growth and spiritual development.
data.etymology: Ashfaque belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of the Moon.”
